ui.an_administrator_must_give_a_reason: Woyang'anira ayenera kupereka chifukwa. Chosiyidwacho chimalembedwa m'mbiri ya kafukufuku.

ui.automatic_protection_keeps_running_on: Chitetezo chodzichitira chokha chikupitirira pa chipangizo chilichonse. Izi ndi zochita zomwe zikufunika munthu kuti asankhe.
ui.by_default_the_agent_sends_security: Mwachisawawa ejenti imatumiza telemetry ya chitetezo ndi ma hash a mafayilo: mayina a ma pulosesi ndi mizere ya malamulo, njira za mafayilo, metadata ya kulumikizana kwa netiweki, ndi zopezeka. Zomwe zili m'mafayilo zimasonkhanitsidwa pokhapokha bungwe lanu litayatsa zimenezo.
ui.coverage_by_protection_layer: Kufikira malinga ndi mlingo wa chitetezo
ui.during_the_free_trial_and_on: Pa nthawi yoyesera yaulere, ndi pa mapulani osalipiridwa, konsoli imawonetsa malonda a Google AdSense ndipo mapulogalamu a foni amawonetsa malonda a Google AdMob, atakupemphani chilolezo. Olembetsa amawona malonda ochepa ndi 95%. Malonda sawonekera konse pa masamba a zivomerezo, kuletsa, machenjezo a ziwopsezo, kuwunika kwaokha, kulowa, kulipira kapena kafukufuku.
ui.each_publish_creates_a_new_signed: Kusindikiza kulikonse kumapanga mtundu watsopano wosainidwa. Zipangizo zimapitiriza kutsatira mtundu womaliza wotsimikizika zikakhala kuti sizili pa intaneti.
ui.equality_software_ltd_operates_agenti: Equality Software Ltd ndiyo imayendetsa Agentic Antivirus. Tsamba ili likufotokoza zomwe ntchitoyi imasonkhanitsa. Liyenera kuwunikidwa ndi mwini malonda asanasindikizidwe.
ui.every_action_that_changes_a_device: Chochita chilichonse chomwe chimasintha chipangizo, akaunti kapena kayendedwe ka deta chimadutsa mu injini ya ndondomeko ndi ulamuliro wa AEP-X. Chivomerezo chimakhudza chochita chimodzi, zolinga zake zenizeni, bungwe ili, ndi nthawi yokhazikika.
ui.every_upload_is_checked_for_malware: Chilichonse chokwezedwa chimawunikidwa ngati chili ndi malware ndi mtundu wake weniweni. Mafayilo opanda chowonera chotsimikizika amasungidwa ndipo amatsitsidwa koma sawonetsedwa.
ui.get_the_agent_for_windows_mac: Pezani ejenti ya Windows, Mac kapena Linux kuchokera ku
ui.go_to_devices_choose_enrol_a: Pitani ku Zipangizo, sankhani Lembetsani chipangizo, ndipo yendetsani lamulo lowonetsedwa pa kompyuta yomwe mukufuna kuteteza. Ejenti imayamba kusikani ikangolandira ndondomeko yake yosainidwa.
ui.i_understand_devices_will_stop_scanni: Ndikumvetsa kuti zipangizo zisiya kusikani ndi kuletsa ziwopsezo pambuyo pa kuyesa mpaka kulembetsa kulipiridwe.
ui.include_the_language_model_if_your: Phatikizani mtundu wa chilankhulo (ngati bungwe lanu layatsa)
ui.known_malware_is_moved_to_quarantine: Malware yodziwika imasunthidwa kwaokha, komwe singathe kuyenda. Ngati mukuganiza kuti fayilo yaletsedwa molakwika, tsegulani Kwaokha ndipo pemphani kuwunikanso. Woyang'anira amasankha, ndipo fayilo imabwerera pokhapokha sikani yatsopano itapeza kuti ndi yoyera.
ui.languages_without_a_complete_translat: Zilankhulo zopanda kumasulira kwathunthu zimabwerera ku Chingerezi. Kufikira kumayezedwa, sikuyerekezeredwa.
ui.management_hosts_kept_reachable_durin: Ma host oyang'anira omwe amapezekabe pa nthawi yopatula
ui.name: Dzina

ui.on_android_subscribe_in_the_agentic: Pa Android, lembetsani mu pulogalamu ya Agentic Antivirus kudzera pa Google Play. Pa iPhone ndi iPad, kulembetsa kudzera pa App Store sikunapezeke. Kulipira pa webusaiti sikunapezeke.
ui.per_user_covers_all_of_their: Pa wogwiritsa ntchito aliyense (zimakhudza zipangizo zake zonse)
ui.read_aloud_and_dictation_use_your: Kuwerenga mokweza ndi kulemba ndi mawu zimagwiritsa ntchito mawonekedwe a mawu omangidwa mu msakatuli wanu. Sitijambula kapena kusunga mawu.
ui.stopping_processes_isolating_devices_: Kuimitsa ma pulosesi, kupatula zipangizo, kubwezera mafayilo, kuwonjezera zosiyidwa ndi kusintha malamulo a kayendedwe ka deta zimafunika munthu kuti azivomereze. Chivomerezo chimakhudza chochita chimodzi, zolinga zake zenizeni ndi nthawi yochepa. Ngati chilichonse chisintha, vomerezaninso.
ui.subscribe_this_device_with_google_pla: Lembetsani chipangizo ichi ndi Google Play
ui.the_assistant_groups_related_alerts_l: Wothandizira amagawa machenjezo ogwirizana, amalemba zomwe zawonedwa ndi maulalo opita ku umboni, ndipo amalemba chilichonse chomwe sangatsimikizire ngati lingaliro. Atha kupereka zochita koma sangazivomereze. Ngati mtundu wa AI sukupezeka, sikani, machenjezo ndi mayankho apamanja zikupitirira kugwira ntchito.
ui.tls_only_must_be_on_the: TLS yokha, iyenera kukhala pa mndandanda wololedwa wotuluka
ui.traffic_floods_are_absorbed_by_your: Kusefukira kwa kayendedwe ka deta kumalandiridwa ndi wopereka wanu wakumtunda. Pano mumawerengera malo onse ofikira a anthu onse, kuyang'anira machenjezo a wopereka, ndi kuvomereza zoletsa zatsopano za kayendedwe ka deta.
ui.turn_on_protection_to_scan_files: Yatsani chitetezo kuti musikani mafayilo pa kompyuta iyi ndi kuyang'anira ransomware ndi kubedwa kwa zizindikiro zolowera.
ui.we_show_adverts_from_google_adsense: Timawonetsa malonda ochokera ku Google AdSense pa masamba ena. Mulola malonda okonzedwera inu?
